description: Fix Kanban board UX breaks around Cancelled issues: unify the cancelled term across state/UI/tests, move the desktop toggle inside the Cancelled column with bidirectional show/hide, fix the mobile tab count to reflect real cancelled issue counts, and restore the Cancelled status pill on issue cards.

tasks.title: Rename showClosed state and helper APIs in kanban-grouping to cancelled
tasks.description: In packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/model/kanban-grouping.ts, rename the React-facing helper API and derived values to use the cancelled term: filterClosedFromDone → filterCancelledFromColumns, getDoneColumnCounts → getCancelledColumnCount, closedCount → cancelledCount, and the second parameter showClosed → showCancelled. Update any other identifier or comment that uses closed/Closed as a synonym for cancelled.
acceptanceCriteria: filterClosedFromDone is renamed to filterCancelledFromColumns in kanban-grouping.ts
getDoneColumnCounts is renamed to getCancelledColumnCount and returns cancelledCount (not closedCount) plus doneTotalCount
The second parameter of the renamed filter is showCancelled
No source identifier, comment, or return field in kanban-grouping.ts still uses closed/Closed/showClosed for the cancelled concept
Existing callers (KanbanBoard.tsx, tests) still compile after the rename, with caller-side updates applied in subsequent tasks
tasks.notes: Pure rename at the model layer. D1 in design.md.

tasks.title: Stop clearing Cancelled column issues in the grouping helper
tasks.description: In kanban-grouping.ts, change filterCancelledFromColumns into a documented identity function that always returns the input column array unchanged, regardless of showCancelled. Add a JSDoc note explaining it is a render/decide-visibility seam and that visibility must not be expressed by mutating issues. The Cancelled column must carry its full set of issues through the grouping pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: filterCancelledFromColumns returns the same column array reference it received (e.g. expect(result).toBe(columns) holds)
When called with showCancelled=false on a column set that has cancelled issues, the Cancelled column.issues array is unchanged from the input
When called with showCancelled=true, the result equals the input
A JSDoc comment on the helper explains it is an identity seam and that visibility belongs to the renderer
tasks.notes: D2 in design.md. The helper is kept (not deleted) as a documented seam.

tasks.title: Update kanban-grouping tests for rename and identity behavior
tasks.description: In packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/model/kanban-grouping.test.ts, update all imports, describe blocks, and assertions to use the cancelled terms from T-001/T-002. Replace any test that asserted the cancelled column was emptied when showClosed is false with assertions that prove the helper is now an identity function. Update the getDoneColumnCounts describe block to the renamed getCancelledColumnCount and assert cancelledCount (not closedCount).
acceptanceCriteria: All test imports use filterCancelledFromColumns and getCancelledColumnCount
There is no longer a test asserting that the Cancelled column is emptied when the toggle is off
At least one test asserts that the helper returns the same array reference (identity behavior) for showCancelled=false and showCancelled=true
getCancelledColumnCount tests assert cancelledCount reflects the real Cancelled column size, not a filtered size
npm test -- kanban-grouping passes

tasks.title: Rename showClosed state to showCancelled in KanbanBoard and remove the Done-column toggle
tasks.description: In packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/ui/KanbanBoard.tsx, rename the React state showClosed to showCancelled (and the setter to setShowCancelled). Remove the Show cancelled (n) button currently rendered as a sibling of the Done column at the desktop layout (KanbanBoard.tsx ~:618-629). Update all in-component references to filterClosedFromDone / getDoneColumnCounts / closedCount to their cancelled-named counterparts. The toggle is reintroduced in T-005 inside the Cancelled column.
acceptanceCriteria: KanbanBoard.tsx no longer declares a showClosed state variable; it declares showCancelled
The Show cancelled (n) button rendered next to the Done column is removed from the desktop layout
All references to filterClosedFromDone, getDoneColumnCounts, and closedCount in KanbanBoard.tsx are renamed to the cancelled-named counterparts
TypeScript compiles and the file no longer contains closed/Closed for the cancelled concept
tasks.output: packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/ui/KanbanBoard.tsx renamed state and removed off-column toggle
tasks.notes: D1, D4 in design.md. The actual in-column toggle is added in T-005.

tasks.title: Add in-column toggle to StageColumn and render it for the Cancelled column
tasks.description: In packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/ui/StageColumn.tsx, add optional headerToggle and footerToggle ReactNode slots so KanbanBoard can place a Show/Hide cancelled control inside the Cancelled column without coupling StageColumn to the cancelled concept. In KanbanBoard.tsx, render a Show cancelled (n) / Hide cancelled button inside the Cancelled column (header or footer slot). When the toggle is off and cancelled issues exist, the column body shows an empty-state line and the toggle. When on, the column body renders the issues and the toggle reads Hide cancelled. Toggling is bidirectional and works without a page reload.
acceptanceCriteria: StageColumn accepts optional headerToggle / footerToggle props and renders them in the header / footer area of the column
KanbanBoard renders the toggle inside the Cancelled column (locatable via data-testid="stage-column-cancelled") and not as a sibling of the Done column
Initial toggle label is Show cancelled (n) and the Cancelled column body is hidden when there are cancelled issues
Activating the toggle reveals the cancelled issues in the column body and the label becomes Hide cancelled
Activating the toggle a second time hides the issues again and the label returns to Show cancelled (n)
Other columns (Backlog, InProgress, Done) render without a toggle
tasks.output: StageColumn.tsx with headerToggle/footerToggle slots + KanbanBoard.tsx in-column toggle
tasks.notes: D4 in design.md. Uses existing data-testid="stage-column-cancelled" as the test anchor.

tasks.title: Make mobile tab count independent of showCancelled and add in-list toggle
tasks.description: In packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/ui/KanbanBoard.tsx, switch the mobile tab bar badge count and the in-list Show/Hide cancelled link to read from the unfiltered column set (the output of groupIssuesByStage), not the displayColumns that have passed through the grouping filter. The mobile list body must still respect showCancelled so that activating the toggle hides the cards in the list. Keep the in-list Show cancelled / Hide cancelled toggle and update its label bidirectionally.
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile tab badge for the Cancelled stage shows the real number of cancelled issues (e.g. 8) regardless of showCancelled state
Activating the in-list toggle does not change any tab badge count
The in-list toggle label is Show cancelled (n) when hidden and Hide cancelled when shown, and toggling it shows/hides the cancelled issues in the mobile list body
Backlog, In Progress, and Done tab counts are unaffected by the cancelled toggle
tasks.notes: D3, D5 in design.md. Decouples count from visibility.

tasks.title: Render the Cancelled status pill on IssueCard
tasks.description: In packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/ui/IssueCard.tsx, remove the indicator !== 'cancelled' exclusion from the StatusPill render guard at the pill location (around IssueCard.tsx:264) so that the existing grey Cancelled branch in StatusPill is reachable. Keep the full-card Cancelled overlay intact. Verify that indicators blocked, approval, running, waiting, and drift still render their pills as before.
acceptanceCriteria: IssueCard.tsx no longer contains a guard that excludes indicator === 'cancelled' from the StatusPill render path
A cancelled issue card renders a grey StatusPill whose text reads Cancelled
Cards with indicator blocked / approval / running / waiting / drift still render their corresponding pills; no other indicator behavior changes
The full-card Cancelled overlay on cancelled cards is preserved
tasks.notes: D6 in design.md. Pill is added in addition to the overlay, not in place of it.

tasks.title: Update kanban-board-query tests for the new toggle placement and cancelled terms
tasks.description: In packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/ui/kanban-board-query.test.tsx, update the test that previously revealed cancelled issues after clicking the show-cancelled control: the assertion queryByText('Closed').not.toBeInTheDocument() is removed or rewritten so it no longer acts as a vacuous absence check. The test now asserts: the toggle initially reads Show cancelled (n) and is inside the Cancelled column (locate via data-testid="stage-column-cancelled" and within(...)); clicking it renders the cancelled issue and changes the label to Hide cancelled; clicking again hides the issue and restores Show cancelled (n). Add (or update) a mobile test that renders 8 cancelled issues and asserts the Cancelled tab badge shows 8 regardless of toggle state.
acceptanceCriteria: No test asserts the absence of a literal 'Closed' element as the mechanism that confirms cancellation behavior
A test locates the toggle inside the Cancelled column via data-testid="stage-column-cancelled" and within(...)
The desktop toggle test pins down the bidirectional label changes: Show cancelled (n) → Hide cancelled → Show cancelled (n)
A mobile test renders 8 cancelled issues and asserts the Cancelled tab badge displays 8 in both toggle states
npm test -- kanban-board-query passes
tasks.notes: D7 in design.md. Tests now actually pin observable behavior.

tasks.title: Final verification: build and full web test suite pass
tasks.description: Run the full Web UI build and test suite to confirm the change is green end to end: build the web package, run all unit and component tests under packages/web, and fix any regressions introduced by the rename / toggle relocation / pill re-enable. No new feature beyond what T-001 through T-008 deliver.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build:web completes without TypeScript or build errors
npm test (in packages/web) passes with no failing tests
Grepping the web source for showClosed, filterClosedFromDone, getDoneColumnCounts, closedCount returns no matches in the kanban-board widget
Grepping the web source for indicator !== 'cancelled' as a StatusPill exclusion returns no matches
tasks.output: Green build + green test suite, plus grep verification of the rename
tasks.notes: Final gate. Acts as the human-visible acceptance review. Verified: build:web green; all 66 kanban tests pass; full web test suite matches master baseline (the 7 failing tests on Header.test.tsx, EpicListPage.test.tsx, and SessionPage.test.tsx are pre-existing and unrelated to issue-80). Grep confirms no remaining showClosed/filterClosedFromDone/getDoneColumnCounts/closedCount in kanban-board, and no indicator !== 'cancelled' StatusPill exclusion in web source.
